qa_pairs.question: Which vehicle types use the tailgate window wiper system according to this table?
qa_pairs.answer: E34 touring and E36 comp/touring models

qa_pairs.question: Which component connection requires 10 Nm of torque in the tailgate wiper system?
qa_pairs.answer: The spray nozzle to tailgate connection and the E36 comp/touring wiper console to tailgate connection

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle models are compatible with the wiper arm to wiper shaft assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: E34/E36 Touring and E36 comp, touring models

qa_pairs.question: What section number and title does this torque specification table fall under?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 61-6 General Electrical system, subsection 61 62 Tailgate Window Wiper
